result.rationale: The new Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` then immediately `host.host = ...` (via save_host) with no nil check; #destroy likewise calls `host.destroy` on a possibly-nil record. A stale/invalid id yields NoMethodError → 500 instead of 404, directly verifiable from the diff.
